answer: Sybil resistance can bind each identity to a scarce attestation slot: before an agent may transfer value, it must publish a unique work receipt hashed into a public quill log that peers re-verify. Slot issuance is rate-limited at a network jetty so one operator cannot flood parallel heads in one window. Failed or duplicated receipts are quarantined in a lagoon of burned stake that never recycles to sibling clones, so every extra fake identity pays full verification cost with no shared surplus.
